description: Unique identifier for each customer record
business_meaning: Customer ID in CRM system — links all transactions to a single customer
notes: Primary key — never null. Assigned at CRM account creation.

description: Transaction amount in USD at point of sale
business_meaning: Revenue generated by a single completed purchase
related_kpi: Monthly revenue | Average transaction value | Customer lifetime value
notes: Amount paid by customer in USD. Very rare to be null — investigate if found.

description: Timestamp of when the transaction was recorded
business_meaning: Date and time the sale was completed and revenue was recognised
related_kpi: Sales velocity | Revenue trend | Cohort analysis
notes: Stored in UTC. Convert to local timezone before user-facing reporting. Never null.

description: Customer classification label assigned by CRM
business_meaning: Business market segment determining go-to-market strategy and pricing
related_kpi: Segment profitability | Segment churn rate | Segment revenue
notes: Valid values: B2B | B2C | SMB. Updated monthly by CRM classification job. Null → classify as UNKNOWN.

business_meaning: Whether the customer cancelled or stopped purchasing within 90 days of this transaction
related_kpi: Churn rate | Retention rate | Churn prediction model accuracy
notes: Target variable for ML retention models. 1 = customer churned within 90 days. 0 = still active. Historical label — not a real-time flag.

description: Type of user interaction event captured on the platform
business_meaning: Action the user took — drives engagement and funnel analysis
related_kpi: Engagement rate | Funnel conversion | Feature adoption
notes: Valid values: search | preview | enrollment. Null means event was not categorised — treat as unknown.

description: Unique identifier for each course in the platform catalogue
business_meaning: Specific course the user interacted with — links to course performance metrics
related_kpi: Course popularity | Completion rate | Revenue by course
notes: Foreign key to course catalogue. Null for search events where no course was selected.

description: Human-readable display name of the course
business_meaning: Business name of the product the user engaged with — used in stakeholder reports
related_kpi: Product revenue | Enrolment count | Course profitability
notes: Null for search events. May change over time — use course_id as the stable reference.

business_meaning: Broad learning domain used for catalogue segmentation and recommendation logic
related_kpi: Category revenue | Category demand | Content gap analysis
notes: Valid examples: Web Development | Data Science | Cloud Computing | Software Architecture.

description: Number of days elapsed since the customer's most recent transaction
business_meaning: Recency metric — key input to churn prediction and re-engagement campaigns
related_kpi: Recency score | Churn risk tier | Win-back campaign targeting
notes: Computed at pipeline run time. Higher value = greater churn risk. Threshold: >90d = High risk.
